title: T9 — Gap analysis (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Gap Analysis — T9 TOGAF ADM capability

## Baseline

At the retrospective rework: six P1/P2 findings open against T9. The material ones are
v1-p81-4 (a draft Architecture Board can govern, and an empty charter is accepted), v1-p81-5
(untyped, unprojected artefacts and links with no tenant/project consistency) and v1-p81-6
(Phase H enforces the outcome per review, not exactly one project-wide, and a G-attached
outcome can satisfy it). The seven A–D artefacts, the Statement of Architecture Work and the
delivery contract were absent at the first snapshot; this pass produces and publishes them.

## Target

The five §12 clauses, each an executable test: A–F phase order with mandatory artefacts
(`togaf_architecture_phases.rs`); the design gate (`togaf_delivery_design_gate.rs`); one
compliance level and a dated waiver (`architecture_compliance.rs`); H's single governed outcome
(`togaf_h_change.rs`); an unrecorded review refusing the gate. Plus the record: the twelve
declared outputs, the closure review and the closure chain.

## Gaps and work packages

- **Code:** v1-p81-4 (board liveness, charter non-empty), v1-p81-5 (typed, tenant-consistent
  artefacts and links) and v1-p81-6 (one project-wide H outcome) are open work packages; none
  is waived (decision 0012).
- **Record:** the lifecycle record completed by this batch; the out-of-sequence closure
  accepted as `U3-EXC-T9`.
- **Standard:** none open against T9's templates in this pass.
